title: Replace coach photo at section 4 with new uploaded image

requirements.text: Save the uploaded coach photo (IMG_1635.jpeg — a young man in a black fleece jacket holding a blue and yellow volleyball) as 'frontend/public/assets/generated/coach-yash-bhardwaj-v2.dim_800x800.jpg'. In the AboutCoach page component (frontend/src/pages/AboutCoach.tsx), locate the element at XPath /html[1]/body[1]/div[1]/div[1]/main[1]/div[1]/section[4]/div[1]/div[1]/div[2]/div[1] and replace the existing image previously referenced there (coach-yash-bhardwaj.dim_800x800.jpg) with the new asset '/assets/generated/coach-yash-bhardwaj-v2.dim_800x800.jpg'. The img element must have explicit width, height, and object-fit: cover styling so it is fully visible. Remove any reference to the old coach photo image.

quotes: Delete the old image and add this new image

acceptanceCriteria: The new image file exists at 'frontend/public/assets/generated/coach-yash-bhardwaj-v2.dim_800x800.jpg'
The img src at the targeted XPath location points to '/assets/generated/coach-yash-bhardwaj-v2.dim_800x800.jpg'
The old coach photo (coach-yash-bhardwaj.dim_800x800.jpg) is no longer referenced in the AboutCoach component
The image renders visibly with object-fit: cover and explicit width/height styling

nonGoals: Modifying any other page or component beyond AboutCoach.tsx
Changing any layout or styling beyond the image swap

edits: Crop and resize to square portrait format (IMG_1635.jpeg > coach-yash-bhardwaj-v2.dim_800x800.jpg)
